parameterOrigin: Explicit study/product policy: more than 15 options require search in this task. Not a universally validated UX threshold; adjust deliberately for other projects.

facts.optionCount: Nonnegative integer count of actual provided options.
facts.searchExplicitlyRequired: Boolean if explicitly required/forbidden by task; null defers to declared project threshold.
facts.queryEditingAllowed: Whether the displayed selection field may accept an editable query; not whether novel values may be committed.
facts.fixedValuesRequired: Committed keys must come from the provided finite set.
facts.filteringProviderAvailable: A declared query-aware in-memory/data provider exists or will be implemented in the derived target.
facts.completionAssistancePreferred: Project preference when both defined candidates are eligible. It is not inline-completion support.

scope: Single committed choice; Input is a free-text field, not a competing fixed-list choice control.
